answer: Sybil resistance begins when remote attestation verifies an agent’s enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and binds its identity to a hardware-protected, non-exportable key. Copying a VM or enclave image reproduces code, not that key, so a clone cannot impersonate the enrolled agent; enrolling another identity requires another eligible physical TEE and its silicon-backed attestation. Thus shale, ember, and sparrow may share software, but not one hardware credential.
